sections.text: Introduction

These
procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper operation
and calibration of SPAU130 C relay. It
is recommended this procedure be carried out every four years bases on the first
preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activates required
prior to testing .

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Moustafa Osman ,tested and revised by eng.Ali Ghater , accepted by eng. Farag 
Abo Youseff :general manager, approved by eng. Gomaa Ghater: head sector of Kafr 
el Dawar Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Gaber Mohmed Frahat : WDEPC inspection and quality 
control general director and MPIS coordinato
Safety Precautions

items: The equipment isolation is required.
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety 
 helmet ... etc

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Secondary voltage injection test set .
AVO meter

items: Secondary voltage injection test set .
AVO meter

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Preparation

Review technical reference and
manufacture manual .

Obtain a copy of relay setting
from field maintenance file and compare it with setting on the relay

sections.text: Testing Procedures

Isolate the secondary terminal of the
voltage transformer.

Connect the voltage test set terminals to
phase R (13) ,phase S ( 16 ) and phase T (19).

Inject the three phase voltage (each
phase = 57.7 V) to the relay.

Decrease the voltage to phase R gradually
until the red flag for phase R appears then record VR (pick - up)

Increase the voltage to phase R gradually until the red flag disappear then
record VR (reset)

Repeat the steps (4,5)
for the phases (S , T ).

Inject the three phase voltage (each
phase = 57.7 V) to the relay

Increase the voltage to phase R gradually
until the red flag for phase R appears then record VR (pick - up) and time .

Decrease the voltage to phase R gradually until the red flag disappear then
record VR (reset)

Repeat the steps (8,9) for the
phases (S , T )

test terminal .

If any equipment associated with the
